title: Yummy Quick Frankfurter German Frankfurter Slider
description: A fresh, snappy, and energizing Polish-inspired dish featuring a frankfurter, crispy fry, and low-glycemic-friendly ingredients, served in a mason jar.
instructions: Cook the franks according to package instructions until browned and heated through.
Cut the jar into a flat bottom for stability.
Fry sliced potatoes in a pan with 2 inches of oil at 350°F for 4-5 minutes, or until crispy and golden brown.
Place the cooked frankfurter into the mason jar.
Add the crispy potato slices on top of the frankfurter.
